title: Sedondon
mood: sassy, smug and owning the room
subject: three office friends who turn up to the company annual dinner in the same emerald beaded baju kurung from the same Jalan TAR sale, and decide on the spot that it was the plan all along
caption: Malay idol pop in the K-pop-style girl-group performance format. A hard 808 sub-bass with fast trap hi-hat rolls under half-time verses; the chorus switching to a driving straight kick with hand claps on two and four; bold brass-section synth stabs punching the end of each sung line; a filtered white-noise riser into a short instrumental dance-break drop after the second chorus. Glossy and punchy, the kick and lead vocals forward, the brass stabs spread wide, short tight reverb. Three young female voices trading lines with confident, sassy delivery, the hook shouted in unison as a chant, one half-time rap verse, stacked harmonies only on the final chorus. 118 BPM, C# minor. Sassy, smug and owning the room. No reggaeton dembow, no swingbeat shuffle, no slow ballad section, no audible autotune, no EDM supersaw, no looping plucked-synth hook.
lyrics:
[Intro - 808 sub and brass synth stabs]

[Verse 1]
Annual dinner, hotel Shah Alam, tema "Malam Glamour"
Aku masuk dewan, baju kurung manik, hijau emerald
Toleh kiri, Ain pakai sama, manik sama, potongan sama
Toleh kanan, Mira pun sama. Alamak.

[Pre-Chorus]
Semua orang pandang
Kita pandang balik, okay?

[Chorus]
Sedondon, memang plan
(Plan! Plan!)
Tiga emerald, satu meja depan
Jangan tanya siapa tiru siapa
Malam ni dewan ni kita punya

[Verse 2 - Rap, half-time]
Boss tanya, "Tema group ke?" Kita angguk serentak
Kak HR snap gambar, terus naik story syarikat
Butik sama kat Jalan TAR, diskaun lima puluh peratus
Tiga orang kedekut, tiga orang paling bergaya

[Pre-Chorus]
Semua orang pandang
Kita senyum lagi, okay?

[Instrumental Break - filtered riser into a dance-break drop, brass stabs and claps]

[Chorus - three voices, stacked harmonies]
Sedondon, memang plan
(Plan! Plan!)
Tiga emerald naik pentas cabutan bertuah
Jangan tanya siapa tiru siapa
Sagu hati periuk nasi, kita kongsi

[Outro - brass stabs and one last clap]
Tahun depan, tema apa?
Sedondon.
